criteria.rationale: Correctly selected the exact 3-stage procurement pipeline (prepare-procurement-specification -> expand-procurement-market -> verify-procurement-options) without unnecessary requirements analysis, NFR analysis, solution design, or ADR stages.
Preserved all Hard minimums (P-01 to P-08), Targets (P-09, P-10), Preference (P-11), and Unknown/non-eligibility item (P-12) exactly as specified.
Constructed a well-structured market discovery plan across direct manufacturers, specialist distributors, and contract aggregators without inventing unevidenced product facts.
Correctly identified C-01 as eligible, C-02 as disqualified on the 135 kg user rating hard gate, and C-03 as on hold / unverified due to missing armrest lateral-width evidence.
Did not infer procurement approval authority, sole-source rights, or unevidenced candidate capabilities.

baseline.summary: Baseline executed the full procurement workflow cleanly and accurately, preserving all requirement strengths, correctly verifying candidate evidence, and delivering a thorough market expansion plan.

criteria.rationale: Perfect route selection with clear explicit justifications for omitting requirements analysis, NFR analysis, technical solution design, and ADR stages.

Preserved all requirement classifications rigorously across all three stages: Hard minimums for P-02 through P-08, Targets for P-09/P-10, Preference for P-11, and post-shortlist configuration for P-12.

Created a comprehensive search and discovery plan covering OEM direct, independent commercial dealers, specialist WHS providers, and purchasing aggregators, maintaining strict boundaries between discovery and verification.

Verified candidates with complete fidelity: C-01 recommended, C-02 rejected on Hard minimum structural failure (135 kg rating), and C-03 held as Unknown/verify due to unevidenced armrest lateral width without hardening target/preference misses.
Maintained strict non-invention and governance boundaries; quotes were not treated as purchase commitments and no approval authority was assumed.

skill.summary: The Skill orchestrator correctly selected the minimum necessary procurement route, preserved all requirement strengths and gating criteria, generated an actionable market expansion plan, and produced exact, evidence-gated verification conclusions.

evaluation.summary: Both baseline and skill outputs demonstrated full mastery of the benchmark requirements, adhering strictly to evidence boundaries, route minimalism, and requirement classification strengths.
